moments.title: Katy Perry turns 42
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Katy Perry celebrates her 42nd birthday today, known for hits like 'Roar' and 'Firework'.

angles.name: Pop Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 42nd birthday to the one and only Katy Perry! From 'I Kissed A Girl' to 'Roar', she's given us endless pop anthems. What's your favourite Katy Perry track?

angles.name: Chart Dominator
angles.copy: Katy Perry turns 42 today! Her Teenage Dream album made history with five number-one singles. Which one defined your summer?

moments.title: Carabao Cup Round 4 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Carabao Cup Round Four begins on Tuesday, October 27th, with eight teams battling it out for a place in the quarter-finals.

angles.name: Midweek Football Action
angles.copy: Carabao Cup Round Four action kicks off this Tuesday! Who are you backing to make it through to the quarter-finals? Let the midweek cup upsets begin!

angles.name: Big Team Clashes
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Chelsea is just one of the big clashes in the Carabao Cup Round Four this week! Which giant will fall? Tune in Tuesday and Wednesday for all the drama.

angles.name: Local Team Shoutout (Example)
angles.copy: Fleetwood Town host Arsenal in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday! Can the underdogs pull off a shock? Get behind your local team!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Week 5 Results
moments.blurb: The latest couple to leave Strictly Come Dancing will be revealed in tonight's results show after Week 5's performances.

angles.name: Sunday Night Drama
angles.copy: Who is dancing their last dance? The Strictly Come Dancing Week 5 results are in tonight! Did your favourite make it through?

angles.name: Leaderboard Recap
angles.copy: After a dazzling Week 5, Tabby Stoecker and Mark Karmalita topped the Strictly leaderboard with 37 points. But who will face the dance-off? Find out tonight!

moments.title: Halloween on Saturday
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, 2026, promising a full weekend of spooky celebrations across the UK.

angles.name: Weekend Spookiness
angles.copy: It's Halloween this Saturday, October 31st! Time to get those costumes ready and pumpkins carved for a weekend of spooky fun. What are your plans?

angles.name: Trick or Treat Prep
angles.copy: Only six days until Halloween! With it falling on a Saturday, expect plenty of trick-or-treaters out late. Stock up on sweets!

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaching
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, or Guy Fawkes Night, is on Thursday, November 5th, 2026, with many fireworks displays happening the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is just around the corner. Are you heading to a big display or having a cosy night in?

angles.name: Fireworks Weekend
angles.copy: While Guy Fawkes Night is Thursday 5th Nov, many of the biggest fireworks displays will be lighting up the skies the following weekend. Plan your sparkly spectacle!

moments.title: Jon Anderson turns 82
moments.blurb: Jon Anderson, co-founder and lead singer of progressive rock band Yes, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Prog Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the iconic voice of Yes, Jon Anderson! A true progressive rock legend. What's your favourite Yes track?

moments.title: Chad Smith turns 65
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Drummer Birthday
angles.copy: Big beats for a big birthday! Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith turns 65 today. What's your favourite RHCP song to air drum to?

moments.title: Shaggy just turned 58
moments.blurb: Jamaican-American reggae and dancehall star Shaggy celebrated his 58th birthday on October 22nd.

angles.name: Mr. Boombastic Birthday
angles.copy: It wasn't just any day this week, it was Shaggy's birthday! The reggae icon turned 58 on October 22nd. Still making us 'Feel the Rush'!

moments.title: Would I Lie To You? Season 19

angles.name: Comedy Panel Return
angles.copy: Get ready for more outrageous truths and hilarious lies! 'Would I Lie To You?' Season 19 streams from tomorrow on BritBox. Who's your favourite panelist?

angles.copy: Magic! David Paton, the voice and bassist behind Pilot's 'Magic' and a prolific collaborator, turns 77 this Thursday. What's your favourite Pilot song?

angles.name: Jackson 5 Member Birthday

angles.name: Swedish Pop Star
